name: Eel and taro porridge
summary: Eel and taro porridge with lemongrass and mắm ruốc. The eel is sweet and the taro is soft.
origin: Củ Chi. Báo Quốc tế, on 11 Aug 2024, describes cháo lươn môn.
howToEat: Eat the porridge. Lemongrass and mắm ruốc season it. The bowl is kept apart from eel porridge in Nghệ An and the north.
The hour is Check on arrival.

seoDescription: Eel and taro porridge with lemongrass and mắm ruốc, sweet eel and soft taro.
taste: The eel is sweet and the taro is soft.
